versionLocalization.description:
SnapScore Golf is the fastest way to track golf bets and settle up after your round. Snap a photo of your scorecard, verify the scores, and get instant settlement calculations for every game your group is playing.

SCORECARD SCANNING
Point your camera at a printed scorecard. Our OCR engine reads the scores, then lets you verify before anything is locked in.

29 GAME MODES
Whether your group plays Skins, Nassau, Wolf, Hammer, Stableford, Best Ball, or something more creative, it is covered. Run multiple games at once and get a separate settlement breakdown for each one.

Individual games: Stroke Play, Match Play, Stableford, Modified Stableford, Skins, Nassau, Nassau with Presses, Quota, Chicago, Aces & Deuces, Dots, Rabbit, Defender, Greenies, Banker, Snake, Bingo Bango Bongo

Head-to-head games: Hammer, Closeout, Wolf

Team games: Best Ball, Scramble, Shamble, Four-Ball, Alternate Shot, Chapman, Vegas, Nines, Sixes

INSTANT SETTLEMENT
When the round is done, SnapScore calculates who owes what. Every transaction is broken down by game so you can see where the money moved. SnapScore is a scorekeeping and calculation tool only. It does not process or hold any money.

SMART SCORING
- Full 18-hole digital scorecard with par and handicap per hole
- Color-coded scores (eagle, birdie, par, bogey, and worse)
- Real-time round progress
- Up to 40 players per contest
- Multiple groups within a single contest

BUILT FOR YOUR SATURDAY FOURSOME
Set your bet unit, pick your games, and start scoring. Wolf partner picks, Hammer drops, Snake tracking, and Greenie calls are built in.

COURSE SEARCH
Search by name or location to load course data with par and handicap for every hole.

DETAILED STATISTICS
Track scoring trends, par-specific averages, score distributions, hardest and easiest holes, and streaks across your rounds.

TRY IT FREE FOR 7 DAYS
Start a 7-day free trial for full access, including unlimited scorecard scanning. After the trial, SnapScore Pro is $19.99 per year, billed annually. Cancel any time in your Apple ID settings at least 24 hours before the trial ends. Contest creation keeps working without a subscription.

---

SnapScore Golf is built by golfers who got tired of bad math ruining good bets.
